# 2 Baruch Chapter 75 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**75:1** And-it-came-to-pass, after-I-had-heard these-words-from-Ramiel the-angel, that-I-fell-upon-my-face and-I-lay-there-a-long-time.

**75:2** And-Ramiel said-to-me: "Why-are-you-lying-upon-the-earth?"

**75:3** And-I-said: "Because-I-am-greatly-disturbed, O-Ramiel, and-I-am-afraid of-the-wrath-of-the-Mighty-One; for-it-is-for-the-sins-of-men-that-these-things-are-to-come."

**75:4** And-Ramiel-said-to-me: "Rise-up, and-I-will-speak-to-you concerning-the-righteousness-of-the-Mighty-One."

**75:5** And-I-rose-up, and-he-said-to-me: "O-Baruch, if-you-were-not-worthy-to-receive-this-revelation, you-would-not-have-been-shown-these-things."

**75:6** "For-the-Most-High-has-not-revealed-to-many-what-he-has-revealed-to-you; and-not-to-many-has-he-shown-what-he-has-shown-to-you; but-there-is-none-who-has-heard-what-you-have-heard."

**75:7** "For-many-have-seen visions, but-not-all-that-you-have-seen; and-many-have-heard-prophecies, but-not-all-that-you-have-heard."

**75:8** "Therefore be-of-good-courage, and-do-not-be-afraid; for-you-have-been-set-apart for-this-end."

**75:9** And-it-came-to-pass, after-Ramiel had-spoken-to-me, that-he-went-away; and-I-awoke-from-my-sleep.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
